test_results.probe_method: Fresh raw TCP fixtures bound only to 127.0.0.1; no tests/test_qualification.py helpers imported. Production subprocess CLI used the existing frozen three-case manifest. Asserted real exit status, overall/case success, completed counts, response completeness and artifact bytes/count/SHA-256 on every CLI case. HTTP_PROXY and ALL_PROXY pointed at nonloopback documentation address with NO_PROXY empty; controls still used direct loopback. Direct same-process concurrent exchanges exercised separate per-response budgets. One explicitly marked IncompleteRead.partial seam injection followed a real socket read; all natural truncation/CLI probes used unmodified production behavior.
verified_boundaries: Exact old XX data separator and EOF immediately after 0 CRLF both exit 1, unsuccessful/incomplete receipts, zero completed cases, full 43-byte JSON entity retained with SHA-256 9780091058b8c4022b350a2083dd4d6f5f77ddd4afa70ecb548fe09f7031b85e; valid chunked control exits 0 with three completed cases.

Plain hexadecimal sizes, uppercase/leading zeros, and multi-zero terminal chunks accepted; signs, hex prefixes, whitespace, underscores, NUL, bare LF, extensions and incomplete CRLF rejected. Nonempty/100000-byte trailers rejected without copying trailers to entity evidence.
1023/1024-byte size lines accepted; 1025 rejected. Terminal zero-size lines at 1024 accepted and 1025 rejected. A 1022-hex-digit huge size cannot force an unbounded allocation/read.

Aggregate framing exactly 65535/65536 accepted and 65537 rejected with full entity; 13106 minimal one-byte chunks accepted and 13107 rejected at framing budget. Source bounds every framing read to remaining budget plus one sentinel, caps size-line reads at 1025 and checks trailer in at most two bytes.

Five sequential responses each consume their own full 65536-byte framing budget successfully. Eight concurrent direct exchanges in the same interpreter also each use a full budget; class default counter remains zero. Immutable integer += creates instance state, not shared mutation.

Absolute timeout/shared deadline probes cover size-line trickle, data separator, terminal CRLF and stalled body. All fail with TimeoutError, incomplete receipts and expected received entity prefix; 0.12-second timeout probes finish below 0.5 seconds. No change to existing socket-shutdown watchdog or finite public-input budget validation.

Unmodified stdlib read1 integration succeeds with one-byte socket fragmentation; natural truncated first/later chunks preserve all delivered entity bytes; explicitly injected nonempty IncompleteRead.partial also preserves exact bounded prefix. Exact entity cap succeeds; one byte over fails retaining only cap.

Content-Length valid/truncated controls remain correct; duplicate Content-Length/Transfer-Encoding, unsupported transfer list, length+transfer conflict and encoded bodies still reject before retaining entity bytes.

All 84 focused tests independently rerun, including IPv4/IPv6 proxy controls, endpoint rejection before network, redirects, pre-network public manifest/image validation, hash/traversal/symlink boundaries, fd-pinned output race, exclusive writes and partial-failure receipts. Complete diff leaves these security paths unchanged.
limitations: CPU/local-fixture transport qualification only. No physical model, 27B, GPU residency/placement, dual-host RPC, GUI or autonomy approval; every CLI receipt attestation remains false.

No source/document edits, GPU/SSH/model calls, installs, downloads, live-target polling or commits. Bytecode, pytest cache and Ruff cache disabled. Only new workspace file is this exclusive v2 report; scripts/results/HTTP fixtures are scratch-local.
Workspace is not a Git repository; reviewed full supplied diff and verified every new/context hunk against current files instead of claiming a commit binding.
Review approves the documented strict HTTP chunked subset only: extensions and nonempty trailers intentionally fail closed. This is not a claim of supporting all valid HTTP chunked messages.
